reproductionMatrix.coverage: Repository inspection can establish enforcement and evidence gaps; it cannot establish player-visible game defects without a bound run and runtime reproduction.

observedFindings.finding: runFactoryEvalSuite checks routing profiles, support decisions, required stages and forbidden serialized outcomes; this function does not generate or play a game.
observedFindings.implication: A passing factory eval is routing evidence, not evidence that the generated product meets player expectations.

observedFindings.finding: The generic runPerceptualQa runner uses a 1280x900 viewport, prototype DOM controls, body text changes and visibleSignal token matching. It captures screenshots but does not analyze their visual content in this function.
observedFindings.implication: This runner alone cannot establish visual quality, action feel, feature-specific causal feedback or mobile readability. Separate game-specific runtime and perceptual evidence must be checked.

observedFindings.finding: The operating-model review says to return failures to the earliest responsible artifact stage, while the player-acceptance workflow says failure in any dimension returns to FIX.
observedFindings.implication: The documents disagree about repair routing. This inspection does not establish which instruction governed any particular historical repair.

observedFindings.implication: This corpus does not contain completed human score calibration; that does not establish whether human reviews exist elsewhere.

hypotheses.cause: Some completion claims may use evidence that proves workflow execution but does not cover the rejected player experience.
hypotheses.requiredCheck: Bind one rejected experience to an exact run and build, reproduce it with normal input, and trace the acceptance claim back through its evidence and upstream artifacts.

recommendedNextAction.scope: One user-selected unsatisfactory game and one to three concrete rejected experiences; generated-game changes require the applicable Builder/Fixer route after diagnosis.
outputColumns: why the existing gate passed or did not run
method: Freeze the exact run, workspace, source/build identity and active pipeline configuration.

acceptanceCriteria: Separate observed repository facts, historical run evidence, hypotheses and remaining unknowns.
Identify an actionable method to locate the earliest incorrect or unsupported stage output.
Explain what the existing factory evaluation actually verifies and what it does not verify.
Recommend a bounded single-game calibration before cross-game workflow expansion.
Do not declare a generated-game defect or factory repair complete from static inspection.
